tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /brgya bzhi'i cho ga jo nang lugs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

'dir brgya bzhi'i cho ga ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ston pa bde bar gshegs pa yis/ /bstan pa'i dam chos rin chen 'di/ /nam zhig nub la nye ba'i dus/ /sngags pa nang dbyen byed pa 'byung*/ /sngags pa'i nang dgras bstan pa dkrug /de ni bsgral ba'i zhing yin pa/ /thub pa'i bden pa'i dgra bzlog phyir/ /ban bon log lta dam log rnams/ / bdud bzhi sher snying bzlog par gyis /rab tu sngags la spyod par bya/ / oṃ swā sti/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brgya bzhi'i gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pa 'di la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang*/ brgya bzhi'i rdzas bsags pa'o/ / dang po ni/ sa phyogs gtsang mar maṇḍal padma 'dab brgyad kyi nang du thub pa'i phyag g.yas pa gan rkyal gyi phyag rgya phyag mgo yongs rdzogs phyag dar gyi phyed tsam bcas pa bri/ phyag mthil du'ang padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar thub pa'i sku gzugs bshams/ de'i mthar nyer spyod kyis bskor/ gnyis pa rdzas bsags pa ni/ sātstsha rab gnas byas pa brgya/ rtsi mar gyi mar me brgya/ 'bru zan gyi gtor ma brgya/ 'bras zan gyi ngar mi brgya sogs phyag mthil du phyogs bzhir bkod/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag ji 'byor dang*/ mchod pa nyer spyod/ glud rdzongs dang bcas pa thams cad tshogs par bya'o/ / gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdag nyid lhar gsal ba/ sngon gyi 'byung khungs/ spyan drangs pa/ bzhugs su gsol ba/ brgya bzhi mchod pa/ mchod pa gzhan 'bul ba/ bstod pa/ 'phrin las bcol ba ste brgyad do/ / dang po ni/ thog mar mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la= lan bdun brjod/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi= sogs/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs bya'o/ / rang nyid skad cig gis thub par gsal ba'i snying gar āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hūṃ gser mdog can/

de las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkhar thub pa chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ shākya mu ni sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ pra titstsha swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ nas shapta āḥhūṃ/ gi bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ gi bar lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa/ stong pa ra sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri'i phyogs bzhir bdud bzhi/ mtshams bzhir seṅge bzhis btegs pa'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ las rdo rje ser po hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid thub pa chen po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ na bza' chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ dbu'i gtsug tor dngabacas pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad thub pa chen po'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ <spro na ma lus sems can sogs/ bcom ldan bskal ba sogs/> oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ nas oṃ badzra a be sha ya a/ gnyis su med par thim/ de dag gi phyag rgya spyi 'gros ltar mdzad de/ yang snying gis hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dza/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btabs pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ na mo ratna tra ya yā/ na mo shākya mu ni ye ta thā ga ta ya/ ar hā te samyag saṃ buddha ya/ tādya thā/ oṃ mu ni mahā mu ni shākya mu ni ye swāhā/ oṃ āḥbadzra hūṃ swāhā/

zhes bzlas ci nus bya/ ༈ skabs 'dir zab mdo ci nus bzlas par bya/ <mdun bskyed ni brgya bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dbus kyi thub sku la dmigs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar de bzhin de gshegs pa sogs/ zab mdo ci nus bya/ bzlog pa mi rgyab/ mchod bstod/> gong bzhin arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sa sogs kyis bstod/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pa'i/ mdos 'don pa/ kye sum cu rtsa gsum lha yi yul gyi dbus/ khang bzang rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang nas/ /rin chen khri la lha dbang brgya byin ni/ /dga' mgur 'dod yon dag la spyod pa'i tshe/ /sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen gyis bskul te/ /glo bur bdud bzhi'i thabs kyis non pa gyur/ /bde med sdug bsngal drag pos gzir ba la/ /bcom ldan shākya'i gtso la skyabs song bas/ /de tshe bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis/ 'gro ba kun la phan phyir ting 'dzin gyis/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po legs bshams nas/ /mchod sbyin phyag rgyas mthun pa'i rdzas bsags nas/ /skye mched mu bzhi'i gnas nas bdud bzhi rnams/ /thugs rjes lcags kyus bkug nas phyag sor bzhir/ /bkod nas bdud bzhir mchod sbyin byin pa yis/ /brgya byin nad dang sdug bsngal kun las thar/ / lan gsum/ mthar gsum pa ni/ a mṛ ta sa sangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ dkyil 'khor stong pa nyid du 'gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte bar ge sar dang bcas pa'i steng mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya phyag g.yas pa gan rkyal du gnas par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros skye mched mu bzhi'i gnas nas bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ kyai/ nam mkha' mtha' yas lha yi pho brang nas/ /mi gnas myang 'das thob la bar du gcod/ /phung po'i bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ / gnas 'dir spyan 'dren mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /rnam shes mtha' yas lha yi pho brang nas/

/gnas lugs mngon gsum mthong la bar du gcod/ /nyon mongs bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /ci yang med pa'i lha yi pho brang nas/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thob la bar du gcod/ /lha bu'i bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /'du shes med min lha yi pho brang nas/ /tshe srog mtha' ru phyin la bar du gcod/ /'chi bdag bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ / bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba nas/ kyai phung po'i bdud ni dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin/ /nyon mongs bdud ni ser po nor bu 'dzin/ /lha'i bu bdud ni dmar po padma 'dzin/ /'chi bdag bdud ni nag po ral gri 'dzin/ / rang rang 'khor gyi tshogs kyi yongs su bskor/ /phyag sor bzhi yi rtse mor bzhugs su gsol/ / rgyas par na 'gugs 'dren sogs yig rnying na gsal/ lnga pa brgya bzhi'i mchod pa ni/ rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag drug gi byin rlabs ni/ chos nyid rnam dag gi phyag rgya thal mo khong stong snying gar sbyar/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swā bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ lan gsum/ zhes pas/ ma dag pa rnams sbyangs nas stong pa nyid du bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya thal mo sbyor ba las tshig bar pa gsum bcag pa dpral ba ru bya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thad khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa e maṃ ga gā na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum/ zhes pas/ mgron so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa'i yo byad rnams nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyad par bsam/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya thal mo phyir bskyed/ mthe bong bsnol ba'i thad du bya/ oṃ badzra amṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ zhes pas/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/

rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi phyag rgya/ g.yon khu tshur steng du bzhag la/ g.yas pa'i khu tshur sdigs mdzub gtor ma la gtad de/ na māḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā wa lo ke te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūṃ/ lan gsum/ zhes pas/ 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin mtha' yas pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi spyod yul du 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bar bsam/ ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya/ g.yon snying gar snod 'degs tshul dang*/ g.yas skyabs sbyin gyis phyag rgya bca'/ oṃ dzñā na a wā lo ki te/ na ma santa spha ra ṇa rasm-i bha wa sa mā ya mahā ma ṇi du ru du ru hrī da ya dzwa la ni hūṃ/ lan gsum zhes pas/ lus zhing gi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa 'phags pa rnams la phul bas mnyes shing*/ sems can rnams kyang rang rang gi 'dod yon la rtsod pa med cing mthun pa'i bsam pa dang ldan par bsam/ dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ni/ ser mo nang du bsnol ba spyi bor bzhag pa dang*/ na maḥs manta buddha naṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza na mahā sā ma ye swā hā/ zhes pas/ mgron thams cad kyang dam tshig la gnas shing phan pa dang bde ba'i 'phrin las 'ba' zhig sgrub par bsam zhing*/ phyag rgya rnams phyogs bzhir bstan zhing sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod/ <spro na/ bdag gi bsam pa'i > bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum brjod/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags lan bdun la sogs par bya'o/ / kyai rin chen sna lnga'i rdul tshon las grub pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /bsod nams zhing gi mchog gyur chos sku'i rten/ /ri rab tshar du dngar ba'i mchod rten brgya/ /phung po'i bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /me long ye shes rnam dag chos kyi sku/ /bcom ldan mi bskyod rdo rje sku thob nas/ /'gro kun phung po'i bdud las thar gyur cig / <ces 'don mi bzhi yod na nyer lnga'am gang 'os mthar/ de nas gong gi byin rlabs sngags phyag sogs 'og ma gsum la re re bzhin sbyar/>

kyai stong gsum tshar du dngar ba'i snod nang du/ /'bri mar rtsi mar rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /ri rab lta bu'i mar me'i sdong bu la/ /nyi zla lta bu'i 'od 'bar snang gsal brgya/ /nyon mongs bdud tshogs 'khor dngabacas la 'bul/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rnam dag chos kyi sku/ /bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan sku thob nas/ /'gro kun nyon mongs bdud las thar gyur cig / <'don rdung gong bzhin sbyar/> kyai rab yangs nam mkha' lta bu'i snod nang du/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i btung ba mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /bza' dang bca' ba ri rab lta bur spungs/ / bkod mdzes sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma brgya/ /lha'i bu'i bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /sor rtog ye shes rnam dag chos kyi sku/ /bcom ldan 'od dpag tu med kyi sku thob nas/ 'gro kun lha bu'i bdud las thar gyur cig/ <'don rdung gong bzhin grangs bsogs/> kyai 'bru zan rin chen rnam pa lnga las byung*/ /gzugs mdzes dbyangs snyan yid dang dbang po gsal/ /mdzes pa gcig tu bsdus pa nor mang ldan/ /yon tan brgya phrag ldan pa'i ngar glud brgya// 'chi bdag bdud tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bya grub ye shes rnam dag chos kyi sku/ /bcom ldan don yod grub pa'i sku thob nas/ 'gro kun 'chi bdag bdud las thar gyur cig / <brgya phrag gi grangs song mthar/> rang bzhin rnam dag ngang du ro gcig kyang*/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs la/ / mig 'phrul lta bu'i brgya bzhi'i mchod pa 'di/ /brag cha lta bu'i dbyangs kyis mchod par bgyi/ /sprul pa lta bu'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /chos dbyings ye shes rnam dag chos kyi sku/ /bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad sku thob nas/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal gyur cig / drug pa mchod pa gzhan 'bul ba ni/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs la/ kyai rgya mtsho lta bur 'khyil ba'i mchod yon dang*/

/sku lus dwangs gsal 'bar ba'i zhabs bsil dang*/ /lta na shin tu sdug pa'i me tog tshogs/ / dud sprin nam mkha' gang ba'i bdug spos dang*/ /rab 'bar tshar du dngar ba'i mar me dang*/ cig car dri bzang 'gyed pa'i dri chab dang*/ /ro nus phun sum tshogs pa'i zhal zas dang*/ /sgra snyan rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs rnams/ /bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i bar chad zhi gyur cig /mig gi dga' ston spungs pa'i gzugs mchog dang*/ /brjod bral rna bar snyan pa'i sgra snyan dang*/ /dri bsung phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i dri mchog dang*/ kha dog ro mchog ldan pa'i zhal zas dang*/ /reg 'jam bde ba bskyed pa'i gos mchog sogs/ /'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa sna tshogs rnams/ /bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /'gro kun bdud bzhis bar chad zhi gyur cig /'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon po dang*/ /glang po rta mchog dmag dpon rin chen bdun/ /rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun mchod pa rnams/ /bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i bar chad zhi gyur cig /'khor lo gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dung dkar dang*/ /gser nya dpal be bum pa padma dkar/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i bkra shis rtags brgyad rnams/ /bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /'gro kun bdud bzhis bar chad zhi gyur cig / ces brjod/ de nas sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma <'di la dmar gtor bzhi bca'i srol yod/> yod na bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ sambha ra sa bsngags la phud kyis mchod de/ bkod mdzes ri rab lta bu'i gtor ma 'di/ /sha dang khrag gis brgyan cing byin rlabs te/ /bdud bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes la phyi nang 'gal rkyen zhi bar mdzod/ / bdun pa bstod pa ni/ kyai nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la gnas shing*/ /'gro ba kun gyi gzugs kyi phung po la/

/dbang bsgyur stobs ldan phung po'i bdud tshogs la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing gus pas bstod par bgyi/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la gnas shing*/ /'gro ba kun gyi tshor ba'i phung po la/ / dbang bsgyur stobs ldan nyon mongs bdud tshogs la/ /phyag 'tshal= /ci yang med pa skye mched la gnas pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'du shes phung po la/ /dbang bsgyur stobs ldan lta ba'i bdud tshogs la/ /phyag 'tshal= /yod min med min skye mched la gnas shing*/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'du byed phung po la/ /dbang bsgyur stobs ldan 'chi bdag bdud tshogs la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing gus pas bstod par bgyi/ /bdud bzhi'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i tshogs rnams la/ / mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen 'di 'bul bas/ /gnod cing gdug pa'i 'tshe ba kun zhi nas/ /'gro kun bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal gyur cig / brgyad pa 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ kyai bcom ldan shākya thub pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ /mchod sbyin rnam par dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /'gro la bdud bzhi'i bar chad zhi gyur cig

/bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs nas/ bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /lo kegs zla keg zhags keg dang*/ /za keg chags che nyam nga dang*/ /bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs dgra la bsgyur/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ldan pa'i rdzas/ /dbang po drug la rmad byung bde chen bskyed/ /'dod dgu ldan pa'i tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di/ /bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs 'khor bcas rnams la 'bul/ /lus sems ting 'dzin zas kyis tshims gyur nas/ /zag med ting 'dzin zas la spyod gyur cig / gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis/ glud btang ba dang mjug chog go /dang po ni/ 'bras zan nam/ bag phye la glud skye mched dod pa*/ glud rdzong rin po che dang*/ 'bru sna dang*/ zas sna gos sna/ chang phud gser skyems sogs 'du byas la/ chab rdzas kyis bran la/ bsangs sbyangs/ byin gyis brlabs/ sambha ra sa bsngos la/ kyai rin chen mdzes pa'i ngar glud rgyan ldan 'di/ / 'bru zan rin chen lnga yi snying po can/ /phung khams skye mched dbang po'i yon tan ldan/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis ngar glud 'di/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgya'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang bar byin rlabs nas/ /bdag cag dpon slob sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /glud du bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /nor ldan mdzes pa'i ngar glud 'di bzhes shig / mtshar dang mdzes ldan ngar glud 'dis bzhes shig /lta na sdug pa'i ngar glud 'di bzhes shig /yon tan brgya phrag ldan pa 'di bzhes shig /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ /kyai rin chen mdzes pa'i ngar glud rgyan ldan 'di/ /rnam thos sras la 'gran zhing nor mang ldan/ /skabs gsum dbang po'i phun tshogs las 'khrungs shing*/ / nag po'i sde las rgyal bar byed pa 'di/ /rig 'dzin gsang sngags 'dzin pa bdag cag dang*/

/rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po'i glud du 'bul/ /mi las glud dga' mdzes pa'i glud bzhes la/ /bdud bzhi'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la bsgyur/ /bzung ba yod na da lta nyid du thongs/ /bcing ba yod na da lta nyid du khrol/ /bdud kyi khram la btab na khram kha phyes/ /btsan gyi shwa rdo bkye na shwa rdo phyung*/ /klu yis byad du bcug na byad thag chod/ /rgyal pos smyo 'bog gtong ba dgra la bsgyur/ /thes rang sris la rku ba dgra la bsgyur/ /ma mo'i dal yams thams cad dgra la bsgyur/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu= gdon rigs gsum brgya drug cu= /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi= /dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad= /lo dang zla ba'i bgegs rnams dgra la= /zhag dang za ma'i bgegs rnams= /rmi lam ngan pa thams cad= /bdud kyi dmag tshogs thams cad= /'byung po'i dal yam thams cad dgra la bsgyur/ /byad kha rbod gtong thams cad dgra la bsgyur/ / zhes brjod cing*/ glud rnams phyogs bzhir bskyal lo/ /<de yang phung bdud dkar po bya mgo can lan chags 'bru sna bcas shar du bskyal/ nyon bdud ser po rta mgo can mar me rgya bcas lhor/ lha bdud dmar po khyi mgo can dmar gtor brgya bcas nub/ 'chi bdud nag po sbrul mgo can dar mi brgya bcas byang du/ glud dang mi lo bdud steng du bskyal ba bcug tshe/ 'og gi rgyab chog dmar gtor byin gyis rlabs/ mdzod sngags lan bdun gyis bsngos nas/ bhyoḥdamar gyi gtor ma= nas ngang du bhyoḥbar brjod/> gnyis pa mjug chog ni/ bdag bskyed kyi lha la mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ sa tshwa sogs rten la brtan zhugs bya/ sarba bhu ta gatstsha= / zhes brjod la/ bdud bzhi 'khor bcas skye mched mu bzhi'i gnas su gshegs/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /yang rkyen bzlog gal che ba yin na/ /gong gi rgyab chog tu 'di bya ste/

dang po bca' bshams ni/ gtor ma zur gsum la g.yag rog khyu ba'am/ de ma rnyed na glang nag khyu ba'i khrag byug /pug shud kyi sgro btsug /g.ya' tshal gyi steng du bzhag la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du song bas/ gong bzhin sngags drug phyag drug gi byin gyis brlabs/ bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyis byin rlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya sogs kyis bsngos nas/ bhyoḥ dmar gyi gtor ma brjid ldan 'dis/ /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzlog /yas kyi gnas la phar bltas pa/ /nyi zla shi ba'i ltas ngan mthong*/ /lha chen khros pa'i than yin pas/ /dmar gtor 'di yis bzlog gyur cig /bar snang mkha' la phar bltas pas/ /bya rgod sder mos 'dzing ba mthong*/ /srog bdag rgyal po'i than yin pas/ /dmar gtor 'di yis bzlog gyur cig /nags la 'brong rgod rwa 'dzing mthong*/ / bdud kyis g.yos pa'i ltas ngan yin/ /dmar gtor= /spang la sha ba rwa 'dzing mthong*/ /gnyan chen khros pa'i ltas ngan yin/ /dmar gtor= /g.ya' la rna ba rwa 'dzing mthong*/ /gza' rgod khros pa'i ltas ngan yin*/ /dmar gtor= /brag la gong lhag sder 'dzing mthong*/ /sman mo khros pa'i= /dmar gtor= /ri rtse 'ug pa sder 'dzing mthong*/ /gza' bdud khros pa'i= /dmar gtor= /nags la dom dred sder 'dzing mthong*/ /ma bdud khros pa'i= /dmar gtor= /brag dmar g.yag rgod rwa 'dzing mthong*/ /bdud nag btang ba'i= /dmar gtor= /nam langs dmar mal mthong ba de/ /dal bdag khros pa'i= /dmar gtor= /sbrul nag lam du 'khyil ba de/ /klu bdud khros pa'i dmar gtor= /ri dwags grong du byung ba de/ /yul 'dres gnod pa'i= /dmar gtor= /bya rgod khyim du byung ba de/ /rgyal 'gong bdud du 'bab pa'i= /dmar gtor= /pho rog sder 'dzing sgrog skad 'don/ /ya bdud srog la gnod pa'i ltas ngan yin/ /dmar gtor= /shing chen rlung gi bcag pa de/ /skye rgyud chad pa'i= /dmar gtor=

/mo dang rmi lam ngan pa de/ /dal rim 'ong ba'i= /dmar gtor= /bud med khrag ral byed pa de/ /rabs chad yongs ba'i= /dmar gtor= /sha ba grong yul 'grims pa de/ /gcer bu spun dgu'i gnod pa'i= /dmar gtor= /sbrul dang sbal ljong rmi ba de/ /gnyan nad char du 'bab pa'i ltas= dmar gtor= /mun pa nag po 'dzum pa rmi/ /nad rims rnam bzhi yong ba'i ltas ngan yin/ /dmar gtor= zhing la bra ba byung ba de/ /lo than 'ong ba'i= /dmar gtor= /mi la sha ro skyes pa de= /gnam thil 'ong ba'i= dmar= phyugs la rigs min skyes pa de/ /nor kong 'ong ba'i ltas= /dmar gtor= /lug khyur 'phar spyang zhugs pa de/ /gza' rgod khros pa'i= /dmar gtor 'di yis bzlog gyur cig /khang khyim gdung ma chags pa de/ /mgon po khros pa'i= /dmar gtor= /krung krung nang du 'beb pa de/ /tri mo nor la gnod pa'i= /dmar gtor= khra dang bya rgod 'thab pa mthong*/ /mthu kha zug pa'i= /dmar gtor= khyi dang spyang ki 'thab pa de/ /phur kha zug pa'i= /dmar gtor= /mun pa nag po g.yos pa de/ /bdud kyi bar chad yong ba'i ltas/ /dmar gtor= /'tshub ma chen pos 'khyer ba de/ / gri kha dar ba'i= /dmar gtor= bya nag sprin ltar 'thibs pa de/ /lha 'dres srog la brngo ba'i= /dmar gtor= /srod la rta pho 'tsher ba de/ /rgyal po'i gnod pa'i= /dmar gtor= /'og rta sga 'gros byed pa de/ /mi kha bdud kyis khyer ba'i= /dmar gtor= /tho rangs sgo khyi ngu ba de/ /'gong po srid la zhugs pa'i= /dmar gtor= pha gu khu mtshan bu chung nang 'dzing de/ /pho lha khros pa'i ltas ngan yin= /dmar gtor= /phugs su bu tshangs byas pa de/ /yul bud 'ong ba'i= /dmar gtor= khyim la pu shud tshang byas te/ /sang phod kong kha 'ong pa'i= /dmar gtor= /mi nag 'jigs su rmi ba de/ /mgon po nag po'i cho 'phrul yin/ /dmar gtor= /chu chen 'khrugs pa rmi ba de/ /sa bdag nag pos ltas yin pas/

/dmar gtor= /srin bya ku ku nam gong 'tsher/ /'dre mo btang ba'i= /dmar gtor= /phugs su me che shor ba de/ kha mchu 'ong ba'i= /dmar gtor= /rta dri rta sgrog bcad pa de/ /dgra sri langs pa'i= /dmar gtor= khyi yi sgo phug 'drad pa de/ /gri rgod 'gyed pa'i= /dmar gtor= /drag po dmar gyi gtor ma 'dis/ /mi sdug ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzlog /yas kyi bdud g.yos thams cad bzlog gyur cig /mas kyi sri kha langs pa thams cad bzlog /pha tshan dgra ru langs pa thams cad bzlog /lha 'dre'i dmag dpung langs pa thams cad bzlog /sde brgyad dal kha 'dren pa thams cad bzlog / dus min 'chi ba'i bka' bab thams cad= sgra skad ngan pa thos pa thams cad= / mo dang bkra mi shis pa thams cad= /thum thum rmi lam ngan pa thams cad= /sa 'og mi chung mthong ba thams cad= /za kha tshong kha log pa thams cad= /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga bzlog gyur cig /ma bu'i byur 'dre brgyad cu bzlog gyur cig /sngags bon phur kha zug pa= /snga dgra las la dar pa bzlog gyur cig / phyi dgra yid las sems pa= /mthong ba'i dug langs ngan pa= /thos pa dgra yi ltas ngan la sogs pa/ /drag po dmar gyi gtor mas bzlog gyur cig /bal nag g.yang bzhi 'di yis bzlog gyur cig /than bya pu shud sgro yis sna drongs la/ /dgra bgegs mi mthun yul du da songs shig /bhyoḥbhyoḥbhyoḥbhyoḥ stong pa mi dmigs ngang du bhyoḥ zhes rol chen drag po'i sgra dang bcas la dgra yul du dmigs te phyir bskyal lo/ /slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i bdud bzhi brgya bzhis bzlog pa'i cho ga bsdus pa rdzogs so// //'di ni rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa 'khor lo'i mgon po 'jam mgon bla ma tā ra nā thas zhus dag gnang ba yin pas byin rlabs kyi gzi byin dang ldan zhing gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad nges par bzlog par 'gyur ro// //sarba maṅga lam// shu bhaṃ// ༈ dmar gtor bzhi yod na phyogs bzhir zor du 'phang*/

de nas phyogs bzhir mdo bzlog bzhi brgyab/ dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad zab mo stong pa nyid nas gyur cig / ces brjod/ /de nas gong gi mjug chog bdag mdun gnyis la dmigs te/ oṃ shākya mu ni sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ= sogs dang*/ khams gsum pa yi 'gro kun= sogs kyis mchod bstod bya/ yi ge brgya bzod gsol/ sātstsha dang thub pa'i sku gzugs sogs la brtan bzhugs bya/ sarba bhu ta/ sogs kyi khri'i phyogs bzhi'i bdud bzhi gshegs la/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis rnams byas pas legs par grub pa yin no/ /gong 'og gi mchan bu 'di rnams rangabazo min/ rnga ba'i se dgon pa'i bla ma dam pa gsang mtha' sogs kyi phyag len zhal rgyun ltar yin no/ /dge legs 'phel// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 58 -- PAGE 59 -- PAGE 45 -
